summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan (6.5h, strict sequential chain) for strengthening the A2-triangle leg (i)/(iii) comparison from a one-bit aggregate to a per-candidate comparison: a compile-once solver-free evaluator over structure.model_constraints.all_constraints plus a candidate-to-assignment builder (the inverse of extract_certificate), TDD unit tests with operator-inventory/atom-coverage/collision guards, first-divergence reporting wired into the shared Tier 1 helper, tier placement decided by measurement under CI's exact -n 4 --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread invocation, and a Tier 2 clean-skip verification. Aggregate assertion retained (it is the only check of the real Z3 search verdict); ADEQUACY.md/A2_GAP.md edits deliberately deferred to avoid collision with concurrent task 195's in-flight documentation phases.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan for the per-candidate A2-triangle leg (i)/(iii) comparison via a compile-once solver-free constraint evaluator, with measurement-gated tier placement.
